leads.price: GBP 65.00 (about US $85.89) + shipping, Buy It Now
leads.notes: Pewter communion chalice in good condition with surface wear and some internal wear, per the seller. The listing gives no maker's mark or engraving. Ask the seller for photos of the base, rim and interior. From the owner's leads.

leads.title: Antique Pewter Communion Flagon, 11 in., by Boardman & Co., eagle decoration (1820s)
leads.notes: Pewter communion flagon with an eagle motif, attributed to Boardman & Co. The listing says New York. Boardman pewter workshops are associated with both Connecticut and New York, so check the touchmarks against a reference. The seller's description only says 'Antique - see description'. Best candidate here for a marked, dated piece.
leads.action: Ask seller for base and touchmark photos

leads.title: Antique Silver-Plated Communion Pitcher / Flagon, church dated March 1855
leads.notes: Silver-plated, not solid silver. The title gives a church date of March 1855. Confirm whether the date is engraved or stamped, and whether there is a church name or maker's mark. The seller notes dents and tarnish appropriate to age. Strong dated-provenance lead if the inscription checks out.

leads.title: Antique Engine-Turned Pewter Chalice Cup, Engraved Monogram (19th century)
leads.notes: Engine-turned pewter chalice-style cup with an engraved monogram, which could tie it to an owner or congregation. Listed as unbranded. The listing does not say it was used for communion, so treat that as unconfirmed. Ask for photos of the monogram and base.
leads.action: Ask seller for monogram and base photos
